data.one_liner: Dart library to deal with US state names and abbreviations.
data.what_it_does: It provides methods to look up US state names from abbreviations and vice versa. It also lets developers retrieve lists and maps of all state names and abbreviations.
use_when: You need to map US state abbreviations to full names or vice-versa in Dart or Flutter.
You want case-insensitive lookups for US states.
avoid_when: You need international location or address validation beyond US states.
strengths: Pure Dart library compatible with all platforms
weaknesses: Limited in scope strictly to US states
